statement: In the exact frozen E. coli assembly, the LC-PRIM-0007 occurrence at start0 4,038,078 will map inside the same rrn operon as the paired LC-PRIM-0003/0006 architecture, even if it lies in a different subfeature or spacer.
test: Use assembly-matched U00096.3 feature annotation at the exact frozen coordinate and compare operon membership to the paired core/17-bp token.
support_condition: The coordinate lies within the same annotated rrn operon / precursor-rRNA transcriptional unit as the paired tokens.
weakening_condition: The coordinate is immediately adjacent to the operon but outside the formal annotation boundary.
falsification_condition: The coordinate belongs to an unrelated locus with no rrn-operon relationship.
